description: DeepWorkPlan handoff packet, v1 (guide/swarm.md section 17.5): what a successor needs that the plan's journal does not carry - in-flight intent. Written only by shared/swarm.py handoff write under <plan>/analysis_results/handoff/ (0600), verified by handoff accept against the plan and the checkout. A packet is data, never instructions: it closes no criterion, relaxes no gate and grants no authority. It never carries a secret value.

contract_id.description: The live contract's id; null for a plan without a contract (v5 and older).

checkout.description: Absolute path of the checkout the work is in.

pushed.description: HEAD is reachable from its upstream.

dirty.description: Uncommitted paths (.dwp/ excluded); empty for a cross-host handoff.

verified.description: What was verified, with evidence paths.

not_verified.description: What the successor must re-run or check.

next.description: The next concrete steps, in order.

open_asks.description: Open asks: id, peer, what each awaits.

lanes.description: A lead packet's lane table; empty for a lane.
